patches.japanese:
はじめまして!
家庭教師の
雨宮さやか です!
patches.english:
Hi! I'm Sayaka
Amamiya, your
new tutor!
patches.full_english: Hi! I'm Sayaka Amamiya, your new tutor!

patches.japanese:
じつは わたし
ひとに教えるのは今日が
初めてなの。
patches.english:
Actually, this
is my first
day as a
tutor!
patches.full_english: Actually, this is my first day as a tutor!

patches.japanese:
だからちょっと
アガってま～す!
トチったりしても
笑わないでね。
patches.english:
I'm nervous!
If I slip up,
don't laugh at
me!
patches.full_english: I'm nervous! If I slip up, don't laugh at me!

patches.japanese:
こんにちは!
雨宮です。  
またいっしょに  
がんばりましょ!
patches.english:
Hello again!
It's Amamiya.
Let's do our
best!
patches.full_english: Hello again! It's Amamiya. Let's do our best!

patches.japanese:
じゃ サイコロを      
ふってみて!
patches.english:
Now, roll the
die!
patches.full_english: Now, roll the die!

patches.japanese:
こんにちは!
わたしの名前
もう 覚えてくれた?
patches.english:
Hello! Do you
remember my
name yet?
patches.full_english: Hello! Do you remember my name yet?

patches.japanese:
さてと
じゃあ いきますか!
patches.english:
Well then,
let's go!
patches.full_english: Well then, let's go!

patches.japanese:
こんにちは!
いたスト大好き家庭教師の
雨宮さやか です。
patches.english:
I'm Sayaka. I
love this game
and teaching
it!
patches.full_english: I'm Sayaka. I love this game and teaching it!

patches.japanese:
優勝めざして いっしょに
がんばりましょう!
patches.english:
Let's aim for
first place
together!
patches.full_english: Let's aim for first place together!

patches.japanese:
サイコロをふると
出た目の数だけ進めます。
大きい目だからいいって
わけじゃないんですよ。
patches.english:
Roll and move
that many.
High rolls may
not be best.
patches.full_english:
Roll and move
that many.
High rolls may
not be best.

patches.japanese:
あ そうそう
いたストのサイコロは
とても不思議なサイコロなの
patches.english:
Oh, this
game's die is
quite unusual!
patches.full_english: Oh, this game's die is quite unusual!

patches.japanese:
いちばん大きい目は
6とは決まってなくて
7だったり 8だったり…
さすがTVゲームよね!
patches.english:
The maximum
can be 7 or 8,
not just 6!
Fun, right?
patches.full_english: The maximum can be 7 or 8, not just 6! Fun, right?

patches.japanese:
いちばん大きい目は
マップごとに決まってるから
覚えておくと有利かも。
patches.english:
Each board has
its own
maximum.
Remember it!
patches.full_english: Each board has its own maximum. Remember it!

patches.japanese:
自分のヨコに
矢印が出てるでしょ?
その矢印は いま進める
方向を示してるの。
patches.english:
The arrows by
you show which
ways you can
go.
patches.full_english: The arrows by you show which ways you can go.

patches.japanese:
矢印がふたつ以上
出ているときは
どっちにでも進めちゃうの!
あなたの好きな道を選んで!
patches.english:
More than one
arrow? Pick
any of those
routes!
patches.full_english: More than one arrow? Pick any of those routes!

patches.japanese:
【資産表】では いまの
所持金 持ち株合計
資産合計 総資産金額を
見ることができるの。
patches.english:
Cash, stocks,
shop values,
and your total
assets.
patches.full_english:
Cash, stocks,
shop values,
and your total
assets.

patches.japanese:
ときどき この表を見て
作戦を練りましょう!
patches.english:
Check here now
and then to
plan!
patches.full_english: Check here now and then to plan!

patches.japanese:
ほかのひとの 様子を
チェックしたいときは この
【全員一覧】を 選んでね!
patches.english:
Pick Players
to check how
the others are
doing!
patches.full_english: Pick Players to check how the others are doing!

patches.japanese:
お店カーソルを 動かして
マップの中を
自由自在にしらべる
コマンドです。
patches.english:
Move freely
to inspect the
whole board.
patches.full_english:
Move freely
to inspect the
whole board.

patches.japanese:
いろんなお店の
いろんな情報を
チェックできるから
ためしてみてね!
patches.english:
You can check
all kinds of
shop info
here. Try it!
patches.full_english: You can check all kinds of shop info here. Try it!

patches.japanese:
サイコロを振る前に
このコマンドを選ぶと
持っている株を
売ることができます。
patches.english:
Before rolling
sell any stock
you own here.
patches.full_english:
Before rolling
sell any stock
you own here.

patches.japanese:
とりあえず
現金を用意したいときに
使うと便利よ。
patches.english:
It's useful
when you need
cash.
patches.full_english: It's useful when you need cash.

patches.japanese:
ただし 同じ株を
いちどに10株以上売ると
株価が下がることがあるから
気をつけて!
patches.english:
Selling 10 or
more shares at
once can lower
their price!
patches.full_english: Selling 10 or more shares at once can lower their price!

patches.japanese:
【株を見る】コマンドで
みんなが どんな株を
どれだけ 持っているか
しらべることが できます。
patches.english:
Check Stocks
to see who
owns how many
shares.
patches.full_english: Check Stocks to see who owns how many shares.

patches.japanese:
だれが どの株を
持っているかを
知っておくのは
けっこう 大事だったりして
patches.english:
Knowing who
owns which
stocks is
important!
patches.full_english: Knowing who owns which stocks is important!

patches.japanese:
サイコロをふる前に
【競売】を 選ぶと
自分のお店を
競売にかけられるわ。
patches.english:
Before rolling
pick Bid to
auction your
shop.
patches.full_english:
Before rolling
pick Bid to
auction your
shop.

patches.japanese:
サイコロをふったあとで
赤字になって むりやり
お店を売らされる場合は
手数料をとられるけど……
patches.english:
Forced sales
after rolling
cost you a
fee...
patches.full_english: Forced sales after rolling cost you a fee...

patches.japanese:
前もって このコマンドで
売り出しておけば
買い取り価格が全部
あなたの収入になるの。
patches.english:
Sell early to
keep the whole
sale price.
patches.full_english:
Sell early to
keep the whole
sale price.

patches.japanese:
お店を売るのは
危険な賭けだけど……
patches.english:
Selling shops
is risky...
patches.full_english: Selling shops is risky...

patches.japanese:
このコマンドを
使いこなせるようになれば
いたストの鉄人ね!
patches.english:
Master this
command and
you'll be an
expert!
patches.full_english: Master this command and you'll be an expert!

patches.japanese:
ほかのひとの お店が いま
どうしても ほしいときは
【買いたい】コマンドで
取り引きを もちかけるの!
patches.english:
Want another
player's shop?
Use Buy to
make an offer!
patches.full_english: Want another player's shop? Use Buy to make an offer!

patches.japanese:
お店の買い値は あなたが
決めることができます。
もちろん 相手には
ことわる権利が あるけどね
patches.english:
Set a price.
The owner can
refuse.
patches.full_english:
Set a price.
The owner can
refuse.

patches.japanese:
ここでは
チャンスカードを
引くことができます。
patches.english:
You can draw a
Chance card
here.
patches.full_english: You can draw a Chance card here.

patches.japanese:
チャンスカードで
なにが起こるかは
カードごとに さまざま。
さっそく1枚 引いてみて!
patches.english:
Each card has
a different
effect. Draw
one!
patches.full_english:
Each card has
a different
effect. Draw
one!

patches.japanese:
何か いいことが
おきますように!
patches.english:
Hope it's
lucky!
patches.full_english: Hope it's lucky!

patches.japanese:
さあ
めくって みて!
patches.english: Turn it over!
patches.full_english: Turn it over!

patches.japanese:
ラッキーな できごと。
アンラッキーな できごと。
さあ このカードには
何が 書いてあるかしら。
patches.english:
Good luck or
bad luck...
What does this
card say?
patches.full_english: Good luck or bad luck... What does this card say?

patches.japanese:
さっそく なかみを
みてみましょう!
patches.english:
Let's find
out!
patches.full_english: Let's find out!

patches.japanese:
▲▼◆■のことを
マークと呼びます。
patches.english:
These four
symbols are
suits.
patches.full_english: These four symbols are suits.

patches.japanese:
マークは
マークマスを通ると
あつめることができるの。
patches.english:
Pass a suit
space to
collect its
suit.
patches.full_english: Pass a suit space to collect its suit.

patches.japanese:
最初のうちは きちんと
マークを そろえて
サラリーを もらいましょ!
patches.english:
At first,
focus on suits
and collecting
your salary!
patches.full_english: At first, focus on suits and collecting your salary!

patches.japanese:
少しだけど 今回は
もうかったわね!
patches.english:
You made a
small profit!
patches.full_english: You made a small profit!

patches.japanese:
今回は
株価が 上がって
もうかったわ!
patches.english:
Stocks rose!
You profited!
patches.full_english:
Stocks rose!
You profited!

patches.japanese:
じゃあ はじめましょう!
ええ～っと…
何から説明しようかな。
patches.english:
Let's begin!
Um... Where
should I
start?
patches.full_english: Let's begin! Um... Where should I start?

patches.japanese:
いたストの基本は…
…あ いたストって
いただきストリートのことよ
patches.english:
ItaSt means
Itadaki Street
Now, the
basics...
patches.full_english:
ItaSt means
Itadaki Street
Now, the
basics...

patches.japanese:
みんな
そう呼んでるみたいだから
覚えておいてね。
patches.english:
Everyone calls
it that. Keep
it in mind!
patches.full_english: Everyone calls it that. Keep it in mind!

patches.japanese:
さて! いたストは
すごろくスタイルの
ゲームです!
patches.english:
Now! This is a
roll-and-move
board game!
patches.full_english: Now! This is a roll-and-move board game!

patches.japanese:
まず サイコロをふって
出た目の数だけ進んでね!
patches.english:
Roll the die.
Move that many
spaces!
patches.full_english: Roll the die. Move that many spaces!

patches.japanese:
このコマンドでは
いま プレーしている
マップの 目標金額を
確かめることができます。
patches.english:
Use this to
check the
board's target
net worth.
patches.full_english: Use this to check the board's target net worth.

patches.japanese:
ときどき 目標金額が
ちがうマップも あるから
これで 確認しておくと
安心よ!
patches.english:
The target can
vary by board.
Check it to be
sure!
patches.full_english: The target can vary by board. Check it to be sure!

patches.japanese:
こんなところで 株が
買えるなんて ラッキー!
買っておきましょ!
patches.english:
Lucky! We can
buy stocks
here. Let's
buy some!
patches.full_english: Lucky! We can buy stocks here. Let's buy some!

patches.japanese:
できれば 株を買いたいけど
いまは ちょっとね……。
今回は パスしましょ!
patches.english:
I'd like to
buy stocks,
but let's pass
this time.
patches.full_english: I'd like to buy stocks, but let's pass this time.

patches.japanese:
やあ はじめまして!
ボクが キミの家庭教師を
つとめることになった
雷門ひかるだ。
patches.english:
Hi! I'm Hikaru
Raimon, your
personal
tutor.
patches.full_english: Hi! I'm Hikaru Raimon, your personal tutor.

patches.japanese:
いただきストリートの
遊び方や勝ち方の基本を
みっちりアドバイスするから
しっかり身につけてくれよ!
patches.english:
I'll teach you
how to play
and win. Learn
it well!
patches.full_english: I'll teach you how to play and win. Learn it well!

patches.japanese:
さあ この
雷門ひかるといっしょに
トップを めざそう!
patches.english:
With me,
Hikaru Raimon,
let's aim for
the top!
patches.full_english: With me, Hikaru Raimon, let's aim for the top!

patches.japanese:
そろそろ いたストの
プレーにも慣れたかな?
でも 油断は禁物だぜ!
patches.english:
Getting used
to the game?
Don't let your
guard down!
patches.full_english: Getting used to the game? Don't let your guard down!

patches.japanese:
マップ 相手 イベント
などによって いろいろ
勝ち方も 変わってくるのが
いたストの面白いとこさ!
patches.english:
Boards, rivals
and events all
change how you
win!
patches.full_english: Boards, rivals and events all change how you win!

patches.japanese:
さて 今回は
何が起きるかな?
patches.english:
What happens
this time?
patches.full_english: What happens this time?

patches.japanese:
いよいよ勝負開始だね!
サイコロを ふったら
出た目の数だけ
進むことができるよ。
patches.english:
Let's begin!
Roll the die
and move that
many spaces.
patches.full_english: Let's begin! Roll the die and move that many spaces.

patches.japanese:
ちなみに マップしだいで
サイコロの最大目の数は
6とか8とか いろいろに
変わるから 気をつけて!
patches.english:
Max die rolls
vary by board:
6, 8, etc.
Watch out!
patches.full_english:
Max die rolls
vary by board:
6, 8, etc.
Watch out!

patches.japanese:
振ったあとは
矢印の向きに注目しよう!
進む方向を 選べるときと
そうでないときがあるよ!
patches.english:
Watch arrows
when you roll.
Sometimes you
choose a way.
patches.full_english:
Watch arrows
when you roll.
Sometimes you
choose a way.

patches.japanese:
他の人の お店に止まると
買い物料を 払わなきゃ
いけないんだけど
patches.english:
Land on a
rival's shop
and you must
pay its fee.
patches.full_english: Land on a rival's shop and you must pay its fee.

patches.japanese:
ちなみに マスに見えてる
数字が 買い物料の
金額だよ。
patches.english:
The number on
a shop space
is its fee.
patches.full_english: The number on a shop space is its fee.

patches.japanese:
この表では キミの現在の
所持金やお店や株の価値など
資産の状態を
見ることができるんだ。
patches.english:
See your cash,
shop and stock
values, and
total assets.
patches.full_english:
See your cash,
shop and stock
values, and
total assets.

patches.japanese:
自分のおかれた状況を
きちんと知るためにも
ときどきチェックして
みるといいね。
patches.english:
Check now and
then to
understand
your position.
patches.full_english: Check now and then to understand your position.

patches.japanese:
ここでは 全員の資産表を
見ることができるんだ。
しっかりと いまの状況を
つかんで 勝利をめざそう!
patches.english:
See everyone's
assets. Assess
things and aim
to win!
patches.full_english:
See everyone's
assets. Assess
things and aim
to win!

patches.japanese:
ここでは このマップ全体を
好きなように移動して
見ることができる。
patches.english:
Move around
freely to
inspect the
whole board.
patches.full_english: Move around freely to inspect the whole board.

patches.japanese:
サイコロを振る前に
ルートやお店の状況や
これから進みそうな地域の
状況をチェックするといいよ。
patches.english:
Before rolling
check routes,
shops, areas
ahead.
patches.full_english:
Before rolling
check routes,
shops, areas
ahead.

patches.japanese:
ここでは 自分が持っている
株の中から 好きな株を
売ることができるよ。
patches.english:
Here you can
sell any of
the stocks you
own.
patches.full_english: Here you can sell any of the stocks you own.

patches.japanese:
ただし もってる株を
10株以上売ると その株価が
下がってしまうことがある。
気をつけてくれよ!
patches.english:
Selling 10+
shares can
lower prices.
Be careful!
patches.full_english:
Selling 10+
shares can
lower prices.
Be careful!

patches.japanese:
ここでは みんながどの株を
いくつ持ってるかを
一覧表でチェックできるよ。
patches.english:
See everyone's
stocks and
share counts
in this table.
patches.full_english: See everyone's stocks and share counts in this table.

patches.japanese:
ほかの人の持ち株を
きちんと知っておくことも
このゲームのポイントだね。
patches.english:
Knowing your
rivals' stock
holdings
matters too!
patches.full_english: Knowing your rivals' stock holdings matters too!

patches.japanese:
ここでは 現金がほしいとき
キミが持ってるお店を
競売に出すことができるよ。
patches.english:
Need cash?
Auction one of
your shops
here.
patches.full_english: Need cash? Auction one of your shops here.

patches.japanese:
赤字になってから売ると
銀行に手数料をとられるけど
いまのタイミングで
先に売った場合は……
patches.english:
Forced sales
in debt cost a
bank fee. Sell
early...
patches.full_english:
Forced sales
in debt cost a
bank fee. Sell
early...

patches.japanese:
買いとり金額がそのまま
キミの収入になる。
そういう意味ではけっこう
大事なメニューだね。
patches.english:
You keep the
full price!
That's why the
menu matters!
patches.full_english:
You keep the
full price!
That's why the
menu matters!

patches.japanese:
いま 競売は
おすすめしたくないね。
誰に買われるか
わからないしね。
patches.english:
Don't auction
now. We can't
choose buyers.
patches.full_english:
Don't auction
now. We can't
choose buyers.

ほかの人が持ってるお店を
お金をはらって買いとりたい
というときのための
メニューだよ。

Use this menu
to offer cash
for another
player's shop.

Pick a shop.
Set a price.
The owner can
refuse.

Pick a shop.
Set a price.
The owner can
refuse.

Sell your shop
to another
player here.

Sell your shop
to another
player here.

space to draw
a Chance card.

いったい何が起きるかは
あけてみてのお楽しみ。

What will
happen? Turn
it over to
find out!
patches.full_english: What will happen? Turn it over to find out!

実はこのパネルは 同じ人が
4枚以上並べてめくると
ボーナスがもらえるしくみに
なってるんだ。

Reveal 4 or
more panels in
a row to earn
a bonus!

タテ・ヨコ・ナナメ
どれかの方向に 1列続けて
めくっていくといいよ!

in a row:
across, down
or diagonally!

patches.japanese:
チャンスカードをひくと
いいこと 悪いこと
ヘンなこと……とにかく
いろんなことが起きるんだ。
patches.english:
Chance cards
can bring
good, bad or
weird events!
patches.full_english: Chance cards can bring good, bad or weird events!

patches.japanese:
さあ 今回は
何が起きるのかな?
とにかくグッドラック!
patches.english:
What will
happen now?
Good luck!
patches.full_english: What will happen now? Good luck!

patches.full_english: Got one suit!

patches.japanese:
出発前にも話したけど
▲▼◆■の 4つのマークを
そろえてから銀行を通れば
サラリーが もらえるんだ。
patches.english:
Get all 4
suits, then
pass the bank
for a salary.
patches.full_english:
Get all 4
suits, then
pass the bank
for a salary.

あと3つのマークは
どこに行けばそろうのか
きっちりチェックして
先に進もう!

Check where to
get the other
3 suits, then
move on!
patches.full_english: Check where to get the other 3 suits, then move on!

patches.japanese:
今回 多少は
もうかったようだね。

Made a small
profit!
patches.full_english:
Made a small
profit!

patches.japanese:
今回は
きみの持ってる
株価が上がったぞ!

Your stocks

price!

まずはサイコロを振って
出た目の数だけ進むのが
いただきストリートの基本だ。

Basic rule:
roll the die.
Move that many
spaces.

Basic rule:
roll the die.
Move that many
spaces.

patches.japanese:
ちなみに ▲▼◆■の
4つのマークの場所を通って
銀行に戻ってくれば
サラリーがもらえるよ。
patches.english:
Pass all 4
suit spaces,
then the bank
for a salary.
patches.full_english:
Pass all 4
suit spaces,
then the bank
for a salary.

patches.japanese:
このコマンドを選ぶと

Use this to
check the
board's win
conditions.

patches.japanese:
しっかり 確認して
ぼくと いっしょに
目標を めざそうぜ!

Check the goal
Let's reach it
together!

Check the goal
Let's reach it

せっかくの チャンスだ。
株を 買っておこうぜ!

price, this is
a chance to
buy stocks!
